# discord Provider

Manage Discord servers declaratively with OpenTofu/Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    discord = {
      source  = "shadow-templars/discord"
      version = "~> 3.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "discord" {
  token = var.discord_bot_token # or set DISCORD_TOKEN
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Discord bot token (without the `Bot` prefix). Can also be set via the `DISCORD_TOKEN` environment variable.
